description: Header file defining internal media support functions for platform capabilities, including support checks for video and audio codecs, formats, and configurations.

methods.name: SbMediaIsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the platform supports decoding specified video and audio codecs with a given key system.

methods.name: SbMediaIsVideoSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific video configuration (resolution, bitrate, fps, codec, profile, level, color info) is supported.

methods.name: SbMediaIsAudioSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific audio codec at a given bitrate is supported.
